activity.notes: During his first Italian campaign in 951 Otto I acquired the Lombard/Italian kingship and retained it alongside his German kingship and, from 962, the imperial crown. ATLAS records the Kingdom of Italy as a separate concurrent Polity Activity.

sources.title: Liudolfinger — Deutsche Biographie
sources.citation_text: Deutsche Biographie states that Otto acquired rule over Upper Italy and the title rex Langobardorum on his first Italian campaign in 951, before receiving the imperial crown in 962.

sources.title: Magdeburg: Otto I. 936–973 — Staatliche Museen zu Berlin, Münzkabinett
sources.citation_text: The Berlin Coin Cabinet identifies Otto I as king from 936, King of Italy from 951, and emperor from 962.
